# Environment Files

This folder contains environment templates and generated cloud/profile files.

- `.env.azure.example` is the Azure VM template.
- `.env.cloud.example` is the cloud-neutral template.
- `.env.azure.foundry.generated` is generated by Azure Foundry helper scripts.
- `.env.profile.generated` is generated by service profile scripts.

The root `.env` remains the active local Compose file for developer convenience and compatibility with existing `docker compose --env-file .env ...` commands.
